Label each accession clearly and maintain isolation where cross-seeding is likely.
Avoid chemical-heavy inputs when plants are intended for medicinal use.
care_instructions: Irrigate to keep evenly moist but never waterlogged root zones.
Weed manually and mulch to reduce contamination and moisture stress.
Harvest plant parts at proper maturity stage and dry in shade with airflow.
Record harvest date and batch to maintain traceability for medicinal handling.
